entries.title: Numbers 27:3
segments: As the cause of every death and of all our evils is sin, all our sufferings should lead us more and more to abhor and forsake it.

entries.title: Numbers 27:5
segments: In all cases of difficulty we should look to God, and seek that direction from him which we need.

entries.title: Numbers 27:11
segments: A statute of judgment; a permanent regulation.

entries.title: Numbers 27:12
segments: Abariam; a range of mountains on the east of Jordan; one of these was mount Nebo, a summit of which it is supposed was Pisgah, where Moses stood when he viewed the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Numbers 27:13
segments: However much any one may be favored of God, however useful he may be, or however long he may live, the time will soon come when he must die, and leave all the concerns of this world to others.

entries.title: Numbers 27:16
segments:
Set a man over the congregation; to succeed Moses as their leader. 
 
A pious man earnestly desires the spiritual benefit of those who may survive him, and will be much in prayer that, after his decease, God will continue to bless them with all needed good.

entries.title: Numbers 27:18
segments:
The spirit; the Spirit of God. 
 
  Lay thy hand upon him; in token of his being appointed as leader of Israel, and endued with the Holy Spirit to fit him for his office.

entries.title: Numbers 27:21
segments: Rulers who seek the teaching of the Holy Spirit, who know their duties, and are faithful in the discharge of them, are great blessings to the people.

entries.title: Numbers 27:23
segments: Gave him a charge; instructed him as to his duties, and exhorted him to the faithful discharge of them.
